answer_1.quote: We envision a wide range of theoretical and applied uses for the corpus... From an application perspective, it supports the development of AI agents to help teach dispute-resolution skills, to monitor and intervene in human disputes, or to replace customer service agents with AI.

answer_3.quote: Following research demonstrating that GPT-4 currently yields the most accurate inferences on negotiation dialogues, we limit our reported analysis to GPT-4o. We prompt GPT-4o to annotate each dialogue turn... GPT annotates the intensity ([0..1]) of six emotions expressed in the turn (anger, compassion, sadness, joy, fear, and surprise).
